what: Local rebuild of the project plugin-sngs export with the tracker settings of the lead 2026-11-15 desktop runtime (GBF-Windows-x64-20261115, predictor/adapter), re-implemented in tools/run_tracklab_leadcfg.py; run on SN-GSR-2025 train clips (revision ce84ee7d9acb2f9fe999ceed2b38e303ffa5efb9) at 1280x720 for the re-entry test

patch_contents: pyproject.toml: torch 1.13.1 pin and the MMOCR stack removed; prtreid and bpbreid from local copies
sn_gamestate/calibration/nbjw_calib.py: metadatas['keypoints'].iloc[0] (positional; the index holds image ids)
sn_gamestate/jersey/easyocr_api.py: the reader built once in __init__ is reused; readtext_batched with workers=0

sn_gamestate/team/tracklet_team_clustering_api.py: weighted KMeans (sample_weight = detections per tracklet) with n_init=10; upstream's unweighted single-init KMeans (scikit-learn 1.6.1 default) split this clip's players by box size, not by kit

prtreid.patch: Cython rank extension not built (evaluation only)

bpbreid.patch: Cython rank extension not built (evaluation only)

tracklab.runtime_patch: VideoReader replaced by tools/exact_reader.ExactVideoReader (ffmpeg, decode order); frames checked byte-identical to gbf's decoder before the run

torch: 2.7.1+cu128 (instead of the pinned 1.13.1, which cannot use an RTX 50-series GPU); checkpoints loaded with weights_only=True and an allowlist of yacs CfgNode and numpy scalar types
pipeline: bbox_detector yolo_ultralytics (yolo11m, imgsz 1280, BGR input fix) -> reid prtreid -> track bpbreid_strong_sort (ecc=True, camera_update wired before each frame) -> pitch nbjw_calib (keypoints moved to cell centres) -> calibration nbjw_calib (1280x720, use_prev_homography=true) -> tracklet_agg (attributes [role], no jersey OCR) -> team kmeans_embeddings -> team_side mean_position
licences: sn-gamestate GPL-3.0; NBJW GPL-2.0-only; prtreid/bpbreid Hippocratic-3.0 (hl3); ultralytics AGPL-3.0 (agpl_network_source); EasyOCR Apache-2.0; weights from Zenodo CC-BY-4.0 (prtreid treated as HL3 by the project registry)

source_data.rules: registries/data.toml soccernet-gsr-2025: local processing and evaluation; publish numbers only, never frames; never committed

lead_runtime_settings.source: GBF-Windows-x64-20261115 predictor/adapter/plugin_launcher.py and runner.py (read, not run)
reimplemented: YOLO preprocess hands BGR so the network sees RGB
BPBReIDStrongSORT.process calls tracker.camera_update(prev, current) when ecc
NBJW keypoints +1 input pixel to the cell centre, lines rebuilt
not_matched: PyTorch 2.7.1 on the GPU instead of OpenVINO f32 on the CPU (same checkpoints)
1280x720 H.264 CRF 18 input instead of 1920x1080 lossless PNG frames
default batch sizes (reid 64, detector 8) instead of 8 and 1
